class.name: MaszynaMoverVehicleServer
class.brief_description: The vehicles simulated by the vendored Mover.
class.description: The vehicles simulated by the vendored Mover ([code]TMoverParameters[/code]), registered with [VehicleServer] as an implementation ([method VehicleServer.implementation_register]). It knows how its vehicles are stepped: all of them together, in the original's phases ([code]vehicle_table::update()[/code], [code]DynObj.cpp:8686-8724[/code]), with [RailVehicleServer] doing what the rail does for each of them.
